summary.name: CookLLM AI Job Matcher
summary.one_liner: An email-based AI job matcher that scores new AI job postings from company career pages and hiring posts on X and LinkedIn against your uploaded resume.
use_cases: Get daily emails of new AI job openings that match your resume
Find AI internships or new grad roles
Find AI jobs with visa sponsorship for H-1B
Reach hiring team members via X or LinkedIn posts
Track which companies are hiring for AI roles
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a resume (PDF, Word, or pasted text), then sends email digests of new AI jobs drawn from career pages of 1,300+ AI companies and hiring posts on X and LinkedIn. Each job is scored on skills, experience and level against the resume, and only jobs scoring 70% or above reach the inbox. Users set filters for region, work mode, level, and daily or weekly mail, and a direct-hire radar emails very strong hiring-post matches separately. The page also describes a free job board that shows which companies are hiring and where job volume is concentrated.
notable: Scores jobs against the uploaded resume and sends only matches at 70% or above
Pulls from 1,300+ AI company career pages plus hiring posts on X and LinkedIn
Visa filter that shows only jobs whose descriptions state sponsorship terms
Free job board with hiring trends by company and area
caveats: The listing tags the tool as paid, but the page itself does not state specific pricing; the page says the job board is free.
Fit score is a decision aid and does not guarantee an interview.
